purpose: Verify a frozen candidate's durable observed intentions against native Freqtrade signal timing, wallet and funding accounting; no economic selection or scoring.
native_warmup: Native timerange starts at 14Z, three flat non-scoring hours before first 17Z intention; startup_candle_count stays 168, ensuring source 15Z has 168 causal returns. All prefix entry/exit slots are masked. The consumed interval remains exactly 17Z to 00Z.
window_rationale: Precommitted seven-hour engineering consumer interval, selected before these observed prices/intent outcomes. Do not substitute favorable past hours or claim readiness before final actual closed bars exist.
input_freeze: After window and publication gate, create immutable intent-snapshot.json and input-manifest.json, binding every retained public source file and actual intent/receipt. Check-only never writes; execute rejects changed files. Placeholders cannot be claimed as actual inputs.
intent_contract: Use observer TIMELY_SIGNAL/TIMELY_NO_TRADE with durable publication strictly before planned entry, actual observed/fetched times, exact candidate/registration/protocol/observer identity and source SHA. Recompute original frozen indicator/gate conditions and compare. Missing or late entry/exit signals remain disabled, never filled retrospectively.
native_contract: One native Freqtrade wallet, unchanged 1x, 1000USDT, current frozen price/precision/cost/funding behavior. Adapter masks only unavailable intent slots, checks natural native conditions for retained slots, and compares actual native entry provenance. No new matcher or pseudo fill schedule.
terminal: Last original native candle is 2026-09-08T23Z; remaining virtual positions are native force_exit there and retained as engineering boundary. Do not label it midnight execution or a genuine strategy outcome.
acceptance: At least one complete timely two-pair hour plus all selected intent/source identities and native accounting verified. PASS requires at least one real native entry; zero entries or missing/late hours yields LIMITED_PASS with exact coverage and omitted hours. Wrong natural conditions, unknown accounting or data gap blocks acceptance.
execution_policy: CLI --policy must name the current execution policy (V3), distinct from immutable candidate economic policy V2. A RUNNING scheduler kind=acceptance claim must bind the actual code/data/policy and native_calls=1. Normal and technical-retry counters remain scheduler-owned.
activation: Acceptance can support later signal-recorder activation before confirmation starts; it does not itself activate the candidate, prove an automatic trigger, establish future profitability, or authorize trading.
missing: Missing source OHLCV/mark coverage blocks native before reservation. A missing/late intent is retained as an omitted slot; no data-dependent date removal. No minimum trade quota or fabricated signals.
